senses.gloss: f. (δισάκκιον = bisaccium S.) bag with two pouches, saddle.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 4:2">Tosef. B. Bath. IV, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 78a:4">B. Bath. 78ᵃ</cite>.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 18a">Ber. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>לא יתנם בדי׳ ויניחם וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (once <cite ref="D00654"><he>דיסיקיא</he></cite>, ed. <he>דסקיא</he>) one must not put them in the saddle bag and place them across the back of an ass.
<cite ref="Shabbat 142b:14">Sabb. 142ᵇ</cite> <he>די׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="D00667"><he>דס׳</he></cite>); a. fr.—
